# RegexMatch

Finds the first match of a regular expression in text.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
RegexMatch(text, pattern)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to search. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. |
| `pattern` | string | The regular expression, in ECMAScript syntax with no flags. A pattern that is not valid is a runtime error, as is a search that runs past the time limit for regular expressions the host sets (one second unless the host sets another). |

## Returns

String. The text of the first, leftmost match, which may be the empty string; null when pattern matches nowhere in text.

## Example

`RegexMatch("order-123", "[0-9]+")` returns `"123"`.
